method: agent-driven via scripts/action.ts, answers from the user observing the screen

pattern.colors: All correct (RGB565 little endian, R in high bits)

upload-behavior.during: Keyboard shows its own loading screen with 1-100% progress for the whole upload, ~1s settle, then the image
upload-behavior.typing: Normal, no lag or dropped keys

slots.slot2: Uploading to slot 2 shows slot 2 immediately (newest upload is displayed)
slots.cycle: Keyboard controls cannot browse to older slots; only the latest upload is available
slots.headerOnly: begin + 04 72 (slot 1, 9 chunks) + commit with no data: no change on screen; commit reply status 0x00 (vs 0x01 after full upload, 0xff with nothing pending)

animation.counter: 5 frames at delay byte 250 loop at ~0.5s per frame -> 2 ms per tick confirmed
animation.sweep: 8 frames at delay byte 10 (20 ms) are fast and smooth

frames.loadingScreen: Shown for the entire upload duration

clock.result: Screen switched to the clock page; time and date correct
clock.animationKept: Custom animation still on its page afterwards

controls.knob: Spinning the knob cycles pages; pressing the knob enters a menu
controls.afterUpload: Screen shows the custom animation page

persistence.replug: Boots to the clock page; one knob turn shows KEEP ME
persistence.power: No power switch; full disconnect/reconnect keeps the image
persistence.wireless: KEEP ME is shown in wireless mode too (stored in keyboard flash)
